name: All-day battery
why: Leaving home without a charger.

name: Android apps
why: Many services exist only as Android apps.

name: App sandboxing by default
why: One bad app cannot read the others.

name: App store
why: Finding and updating software in one place.

name: Auto-brightness
why: Readable outdoors, comfortable at night, saves battery.

name: Auto-rotate
why: Video and photos in landscape.

name: Backup and restore
why: Moving to a new phone, or recovering a lost one.

name: Banking apps
why: Many banks require their app for login and payments.

name: Bluetooth
why: Headphones, cars, watches, keyboards.

name: Bluetooth audio and headset calls
why: Wireless headphones and car kits, including for calls.

name: Charging, including powered off
why: Charging at all, and charging while switched off.

name: Contactless payments
why: Paying with the phone.

name: Contacts and calendar sync
why: The same contacts and appointments everywhere.

name: Deep sleep that wakes for calls and messages
why: A phone that sleeps and still rings - the heart of battery life.

name: Earpiece
why: Calls held to the ear.

name: Emergency calls
why: Must work every time, even without a SIM.

name: Storage encryption
why: A lost phone does not give away its data.

name: eSIM
why: More carriers and devices are eSIM-only.

name: Fingerprint or face unlock
why: Fast unlocking without weakening the lock.

name: GPS and location
why: Maps and navigation.

name: Wired headphones and headset mic
why: Private listening and calls.

name: Hotspot and tethering
why: Sharing the phone's connection with a laptop.

name: Microphones
why: Calls, voice notes, video.

name: MMS and group messages
why: Pictures and group chats over the carrier.

name: Mobile data
why: Being online away from Wi-Fi.

name: Native apps for daily needs
why: Mail, messaging, maps, browser, media, made for a phone screen.

name: NFC
why: Payments, transit cards, pairing.

name: On-screen keyboard
why: Typing, in every language the user writes.

name: Updates over the air
why: Security fixes arrive without a computer.

name: Photos
why: The camera is among the most used features of a phone.

name: Background power discipline
why: The system, not each app, decides what may run in the background.

name: Proximity sensor in calls
why: Turns the screen off at the ear, so the cheek does not press buttons.

name: Push notifications while asleep
why: Messages arrive at once without draining the battery.

name: QR codes
why: Logins, payments, tickets, Wi-Fi.

name: Updates with rollback
why: A failed update does not leave a broken phone.

name: Hardware key store
why: Keys that never leave a dedicated chip.

name: SMS
why: Still how banks, services and two-factor codes reach people.

name: Speaker
why: Calls on speaker, media, ringing.

name: Years of updates
why: A phone stays safe for as long as it lasts.

name: Touchscreen
why: The whole interface.

name: Verified boot
why: The phone can tell when its system was tampered with.

name: Video recording
why: Recording with sound.

name: Voice calls
why: The first thing a phone is for.

name: Voicemail
why: Calls missed while busy or asleep.

name: VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling
why: Many networks have switched 2G/3G off: without VoLTE there are no calls at all.

name: Wi-Fi
why: The main connection at home and work.
